text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Desire, did you watch my birthday present 
to you yet? The movie DVD of "Jump! 
Reincarnation Rider"!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The protagonist awakens a passion for 
motorcycles in their reincarnated world... 
Seeing them tear through the palace on a 
bike took my breath away.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! That scene is so cool, right!? I 
actually did a bunch of research on those 
"reincarnation stories" you like so much, 
Desire!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that movie was bizarre... I'm glad 
Desire liked it, but as a present, it's a 
bit much."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, how did you like my 
star-shaped brooch? It went perfectly with 
Desire's headdress! So, do you think she 
liked it?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that side was beautiful as well. 
Thank you both... for doing this for me.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(—Ah, I see, so that's what's going on...! 
Both of you, doing this just for me... 
Fufufu...!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean, 'more importantly'! If 
that's how it is... let's have Desire 
decide who was cooler!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, obviously it's gonna be me! Don't 
come crying to me when you lose!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Desire! Of course you're picking me, 
right?! Desire! Of course you're picking 
me, aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(Such passionate gazes from both of 
them... Don't tell me they're fighting 
over me, a saintly maiden...?!)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, this too is a trial for the Saint...! 
A destiny destined to reach the World 
inevitably draws everyone's gaze, after 
all...!)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—I cannot possibly choose between the two! 
Ah, world... forgive this sinful 
saintess...! Fufufu...!
